_comment: INGenious action format sidecar. Overrides/augments the @Args annotations at runtime. Loaded from <appRoot>/Configuration/action-argspec.json and from each plugins/<plugin>/action-argspec.json. Use this to spec plugin or not-yet-annotated actions without recompiling. Keys under 'actions' are action (method) names.

_schema.help: one-line hint shown in the IDE and action_info

deleteRestRequest.help: DELETE request. No input. Condition = optional #apiAlias selecting the API config.

executeAdbShellCommand.help: Runs adb shell <command> on the connected Android device. Condition = optional variable to store output.

assertAdbShellOutput.help: Runs adb shell <command> and asserts the output contains Condition text.

clearAppData.help: Clears all data for the given Android package (adb shell pm clear).

forceStopApp.help: Force-stops the given Android package (adb shell am force-stop).

getDeviceProperty.help: Reads an Android system property via getprop and stores it in Condition variable.

pushFileToDevice.help: Pushes a local file to the connected Android device.

pullFileFromDevice.help: Pulls a file from the Android device to a local path.
